entries.title: S01 Open L Kitchen Scene
entries.description: Static L kitchen scene built from five unit-scale rigid instances of four unchanged verified assets: one true diagonal corner cabinet, two complete 1.2m work cabinets, one v2 sink cabinet and one closed refrigerator exterior. Two perpendicular working faces retain all original complete tops, cavities, frames, doors, handles and materials. Nominal 60mm countertop installation seams are visible; the actual corner-front envelope leaves at least 49mm clearance. One new scene-only closed support floor carries every complete original bottom patch at 0.08m. One scene, zero new independent models. Original-ID hierarchy and original internal nodes remain editable in one fixed closed display pose. Static visual appearance only: no seamless installation, moving doors, animation, continuous motion, ergonomic or accessibility certification, water, drainage, electricity, heat, refrigeration, load, stability, manufacture or safety claim.

entries.title: Single-bay Glass Greenhouse
entries.description: One original freestanding empty 2.4 by 3 metre gabled greenhouse shell: a whole open-centre low footing, four original continuous inverted-U portal frames, finite longitudinal eave and ridge members, eighteen individually closed 6 mm true-glass panes across both side walls, both roof pitches, both end gables and one distinct fixed closed front door. The planting interior is entirely empty, including the roof volume, side recesses, end gable recesses and inner entrance approach. One static architectural model, native metres/Z up/front -Y, centred horizontal envelope and full ground datum Z=0. Constant near-clear transmission glass with alpha one, matching IOR and physical-volume thickness; no textures or linked inputs. No shelves, crops, soil contents, lights, labels, branding, animation, window operation, ventilation, climate control, door travel, practical passage, growing performance, structural/weather/glass safety, manufacturing or old-building interface claim.

entries.title: S01 Sofa and Bookcase Living-Room Corner
entries.description: A fixed living-room corner composed from four complete verified assets at unit scale: the original two-seat sofa, wide open bookcase turned toward the seating area, original 0.79m round table beside the sofa and unlit task lamp on that table. Every original mesh, node, solid PBR material and fixed pose is retained. One new closed scene-only support floor carries all complete sofa, bookcase and table bottom patches; the full lamp base rests on the actual finite round-table top. The original table is not a coffee table and has not been lowered. Four complete empty approach regions cover the sofa front, full-width entry passage, bookcase side approach and round-table front. One scene, zero new independent models. A living-room composition, not an entryway or dining layout rename. Static appearance only: no broad furniture compatibility, ergonomic or accessibility suitability, reading illumination, electricity, seating, moving mechanism, load, stability, manufacture, installation or safety certification.

entries.title: Fixed H-frame Studio Easel
entries.description: One original fixed H-frame studio easel with two complete long ground runners, two parallel thick upright guide rails with integral fixed shoulders, lower and upper full cross ties, one continuous twin-through-slot carriage with integral lower board ledge and stop lip, and one upper fixed cap/back-support head bearing a newly authored thick blank board. The complete slots have real closed walls and full-length rail clearance. All geometry is newly authored; no old A-frame easel, blackboard, mirror or sheet rack components are imported. One static prop only; one fixed vertical pose. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, full horizontal bounds centred on its ground datum Z=0. Constant opaque PBR, alpha 1, no texture or linked Principled inputs. No sliding, adjustment, clamping operation, tilt, folding, assembly, arbitrary board compatibility, structural load, stability, anti-tip, manufacturing or safety claim. Original easel structure family and tilt/fold motion remain partial.
